regions.today: A little cloudy and perhaps breezy this morning but it’s largely dry. More cloud builds later however ahead of a band of rain moving over this afternoon. The rain will be heavy at times with some strong wind gusts too. The rain makes way for sunny spells following in from the west early evening as winds ease light westerly and highs of 14 to 17 degrees.
regions.tonight: A largely dry and clear night with light westerly winds. A little cooler too with lowest temperatures of 6 to 8 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Largely dry with plenty of sunny spells and light southerly breezes. A little cloud will drift in later in the afternoon making the sunshine a little hazy with highs of 17 to 20 degrees.
